description: Project scaffold, TypeScript types, synthetic dataset, and all utility functions. This is the data and logic layer — no UI. It must be fully built and compile cleanly before FEAT-002 begins.
steps: Step 1 — Bootstrap Vite project: Run 'cd c:\Users\vs065\OneDrive\Desktop\pod12 && npm create vite@latest . -- --template react-ts' (accept prompts with defaults). Then run 'npm install'. Then run 'npm install recharts react-router-dom lucide-react'. Then run 'npm install -D tailwindcss@3 postcss autoprefixer'. Then run 'npx tailwindcss init -p'. This creates package.json, tsconfig.json, vite.config.ts, index.html, src/main.tsx, src/App.tsx.

Step 2 — Configure Tailwind CSS: Edit tailwind.config.js — set content array to ['./index.html', './src/**/*.{ts,tsx}']. Edit src/index.css — replace ALL existing content with exactly these three lines: @tailwind base; @tailwind components; @tailwind utilities;

Step 3 — Create src/types/index.ts with ALL TypeScript interfaces: Supplier { id: string; name: string; contactEmail: string; country: string; category: string; activeFrom: string; }. Product { id: string; name: string; category: string; unit: string; }. QualityIssueType = 'damage' | 'defect' | 'wrong-item' | 'substandard'. QualityIssue { type: QualityIssueType; description: string; batchAffected?: string; }. POStatus = 'pending' | 'completed' | 'partial'. PurchaseOrder { id: string; supplierId: string; productId: string; orderDate: string; expectedDeliveryDate: string; actualDeliveryDate?: string; orderedQuantity: number; receivedQuantity?: number; status: POStatus; qualityIssues: QualityIssue[]; }. RiskLevel = 'Low' | 'Medium' | 'High' | 'Critical'. RiskThresholds { critical: number; high: number; medium: number; }. SupplierMetrics { supplierId: string; totalOrders: number; completedOrders: number; onTimeDeliveries: number; lateDeliveries: number; pendingOrders: number; totalOrderedQty: number; totalReceivedQty: number; qualityIssueCount: number; onTimeRate: number; qtyFulfillmentRate: number; qualityPerformanceRate: number; reliabilityScore: number; riskLevel: RiskLevel; }. ProductMetrics { productId: string; supplierId: string; totalOrders: number; completedOrders: number; onTimeDeliveries: number; lateDeliveries: number; qualityIssues: number; onTimeRate: number; avgShortfallPct: number; }. HiddenIssueType = 'delivery' | 'quantity' | 'quality' | 'combined'. HiddenIssue { supplierId: string; productId: string; issueType: HiddenIssueType; severity: 'warning' | 'critical'; evidence: string[]; description: string; }. RecommendationPriority = 'High' | 'Medium' | 'Low'. Recommendation { id: string; supplierId: string; productId?: string; issueType: string; priority: RecommendationPriority; action: string; evidence: string[]; poIds: string[]; }.

Step 4 — Create src/data/procurement.ts. This is the most critical file. RULES: (a) No Math.random(). (b) No Date.now(). (c) All data is hardcoded literal arrays. (d) Export: suppliers (Supplier[]), products (Product[]), purchaseOrders (PurchaseOrder[]). SUPPLIERS (6): SUP001 GlobalTech Solutions (category: Electronics/IT, country: Germany), SUP002 PrimeParts Inc (category: Industrial Equipment, country: USA), SUP003 SwiftLogix (category: Mixed, country: Singapore), SUP004 AceProcure (category: Mixed, country: India), SUP005 NorthStar Supplies (category: Safety/Furniture, country: Canada), SUP006 VendorX Global (category: Mixed, country: China). PRODUCTS (10): PRD001 Laptop Batteries (Electronics, units), PRD002 Office Chairs (Furniture, units), PRD003 Printer Paper (Stationery, reams), PRD004 Safety Helmets (Safety, units), PRD005 Industrial Fans (Equipment, units), PRD006 USB Cables (Electronics, units), PRD007 Filing Cabinets (Furniture, units), PRD008 Cleaning Supplies (Consumables, liters), PRD009 Network Switches (IT, units), PRD010 Packaging Tape (Consumables, rolls). PURCHASE ORDERS — minimum 130 records total spanning 2026-05-01 to 2026-11-01. STATUS RULES: if actualDeliveryDate is set → status 'completed'; if no actualDeliveryDate and expectedDeliveryDate < '2026-11-12' → status 'pending' (overdue) or could be partial; use 'partial' when receivedQuantity is set but less than orderedQuantity and there is an actualDeliveryDate. SUPPLIER PATTERNS: SUP001 (GlobalTech) — create 12 POs for PRD001: orderDates from May to Oct 2026, expectedDeliveryDate 14 days after orderDate, actualDeliveryDate 20-35 days LATE (e.g. expected 2026-05-15, actual 2026-06-10), receivedQuantity = orderedQuantity (no short delivery), no quality issues — the lateness IS the hidden issue. Also create 18 POs for PRD002, PRD006, PRD009 combined: 85%+ on time, good quality. Net SUP001 overall on-time rate target: ~72-78% (Medium). SUP002 (PrimeParts) — 20 POs: mix of PRD005 (10 POs, 70% late, 2 quality issues) and PRD003 (10 POs, 60% on time). SUP003 (SwiftLogix) — 25 POs across PRD003, PRD008, PRD010: 92%+ on time, receivedQuantity = orderedQuantity, no quality issues. SUP004 (AceProcure) — 20 POs across PRD004, PRD007, PRD008: 65% on time, 35% of orders have quality issues (defect or substandard). SUP005 (NorthStar) — 20 POs across PRD002, PRD004, PRD007: 60% on time, 15% short deliveries, 1 quality issue. SUP006 (VendorX) — 20 POs across PRD005, PRD006, PRD010: 35% on time, 40% short deliveries, 20% quality issues. Total PO count must be ≥ 130. Use IDs like PO-001, PO-002, ... PO-135 sequentially.

Step 5 — Create src/utils/dateUtils.ts: export const TODAY = new Date('2026-11-12'). export function parseDate(s: string): Date { return new Date(s); }. export function daysBetween(a: Date, b: Date): number { return Math.round((b.getTime() - a.getTime()) / 86400000); }. export function isLate(po: PurchaseOrder): boolean — for completed/partial: return actualDeliveryDate > expectedDeliveryDate; for pending: return parseDate(po.expectedDeliveryDate) < TODAY. export function formatDate(d: Date): string — returns ISO yyyy-MM-dd string. export function formatDateDisplay(d: Date): string — returns readable string like '12 Nov 2026' using toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' }).

Step 6 — Create src/utils/scoring.ts. Import PurchaseOrder, Supplier, SupplierMetrics, ProductMetrics, RiskLevel, RiskThresholds from types. Import isLate, TODAY from dateUtils. export const DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS: RiskThresholds = { critical: 50, high: 70, medium: 85 }. Functions: calcOnTimeRate(orders) — filter to completed+partial, count where !isLate(po), return count/total*100 or 0 if none. calcQtyFulfillmentRate(orders) — filter completed+partial, sum receivedQuantity and orderedQuantity, return ratio*100, guard divide-by-zero. calcQualityPerformanceRate(orders) — filter completed+partial, count where qualityIssues.length===0, return count/total*100 or 100 if none. calcReliabilityScore(onTime, qty, quality) — return onTime*0.40 + qty*0.35 + quality*0.25. getRiskLevel(score, thresholds) — if score < thresholds.critical return 'Critical'; if score < thresholds.high return 'High'; if score < thresholds.medium return 'Medium'; return 'Low'. calcSupplierMetrics(supplier, orders, thresholds) — compute all SupplierMetrics fields. calcProductMetrics(supplierId, productId, orders) — filter orders for that supplier+product, compute ProductMetrics. calcAllSupplierMetrics(suppliers, orders, thresholds) — map over suppliers.

Step 7 — Create src/utils/issueDetection.ts. Import all types and scoring utils. export function detectHiddenIssues(suppliers, products, orders, thresholds): HiddenIssue[] — for each supplier × product combo with ≥3 completed+partial orders: compute product-level on-time rate and supplier overall on-time rate; if productOnTimeRate < 50 AND supplierOnTimeRate >= 50 → push HiddenIssue with issueType 'delivery', severity 'critical' if productOnTimeRate < 20 else 'warning', evidence array with strings like '10 of 11 deliveries for Laptop Batteries were late', description 'Product-level delivery performance is significantly worse than supplier overall metrics suggest'. Also check: productShortRate > 40 AND supplierShortRate < 20 → 'quantity' hidden issue. productQualityRate > 30 AND supplierQualityRate < 15 → 'quality' hidden issue. export function getMostDelayedSuppliers(allMetrics: SupplierMetrics[]): SupplierMetrics[] — sort by lateDeliveries desc. export function getRecurringDelayProducts(suppliers, products, orders): Array<{product: Product, supplier: Supplier, lateRate: number, orderCount: number}> — find supplier+product combos with ≥3 orders and lateRate > 50%, sorted by lateRate desc. export function getQuantityShortfallSuppliers(suppliers, allMetrics): Array<{supplier: Supplier, metrics: SupplierMetrics, shortfallPct: number}> — suppliers where qtyFulfillmentRate < 100, sorted by shortfallPct desc. export function getQualityProblemSuppliers(suppliers, allMetrics): Array<{supplier: Supplier, metrics: SupplierMetrics}> — sorted by qualityIssueCount desc.

Step 8 — Create src/utils/recommendations.ts. Import all types. Import calcSupplierMetrics, calcProductMetrics, DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS from scoring. Import detectHiddenIssues from issueDetection. Import isLate from dateUtils. export function generateRecommendations(suppliers, products, orders, thresholds = DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS): Recommendation[] — iterate suppliers; for each supplier get all their orders; check: (R1) any product with ≥3 completed orders and lateRate > 70% → High priority delivery review rec with productId; (R2) overall qtyFulfillmentRate < 80 → High priority quantity rec; (R3) overall qualityIssueRate > 25 (qualityIssueCount/completedOrders*100) → High priority quality rec; (R4) if supplier has ≥2 of the above issues → High priority comprehensive review rec (replace individual recs with this one or add it); (R5) for each HiddenIssue for this supplier → High priority hidden issue rec; (R6) if none of R1-R5 triggered and reliabilityScore >= 85 → Low priority routine monitoring rec. Each rec gets a unique id like 'REC-001', 'REC-002'. poIds = IDs of the supporting PO records (e.g. all late POs for that product). Never create duplicate recs for the same supplier+product+issueType combination. Return sorted by priority (High first).

SUP006 VendorX reliability score computed by calcReliabilityScore is <50 (Critical)
detectHiddenIssues returns at least one HiddenIssue for SUP001 × PRD001
generateRecommendations returns at least one High priority recommendation for SUP001 × PRD001
